study_goal: Assess sustained shaft output greater than all net external input over a repeatable full cycle. Powered operating points are comparisons only; they do not establish self-running or generation.

parameter_provenance.encounters_and_coils: User's double-sided arrangement: 16 gradients per face, 8 coils per face. Each coil encounters 16 gradients per revolution; 16 coils total. No full 3D magnetic coupling is implied.
parameter_provenance.resistance_ohm: APW EML50mm-24 datasheet 55.9 ohm +/-10% at 20 C; nominal value used, unmeasured on user's unit.
parameter_provenance.bus_voltage_v: APW EML50mm-24 nominal 24 VDC, used here as ideal bridge voltage ceiling with zero reserved switching margin.
parameter_provenance.design_current_cap_a: 0.43 A is the published rated current, adopted as a no-overdrive design cap; it is not a manufacturer certified peak pulse limit.
parameter_provenance.max_gate_duty_fraction: 10% is published actuator metadata, adopted as a reference gate limit only. It does not qualify high-frequency motor operation. Thermal assessment must include all coil i^2 R heating, including hold, freewheel and decay current; gate duty and PWM switching fraction are not interchangeable.
parameter_provenance.inductance_h: ILLUSTRATIVE 5 mH assumption; not measured or extracted from APW or FEMM.
parameter_provenance.pm_potential_amplitude_j: ILLUSTRATIVE analytic 2 mJ potential per coil; not fitted to a FEMM cycle bias, holding force, or output claim.
parameter_provenance.pm_flux_linkage_amplitude_wb_turn: ILLUSTRATIVE analytic 5 mWb-turn coupling; not measured or extracted from FEMM. With the chosen potential, 0.4 A gives instantaneous full cancellation at pulse peak.
parameter_provenance.return_path_efficiency: ILLUSTRATIVE 75% of actually negative terminal energy reaches a receptive DC bus; not a device specification or an assumed deduction of all stored inductive energy.
parameter_provenance.controller_power_w: ILLUSTRATIVE 0.25 W total system overhead, counted once per rotor revolution.
parameter_provenance.mechanical_loss_power_w: Optimistic zero drag assumption to isolate electromechanical accounting; there is no validated shaft-output or thermal model.
parameter_provenance.bridge_losses: Ideal forward conversion, zero switching/conduction losses and no dead-time voltage margin; optimistic modeling assumptions. Return loss and controller draw are included.

target.interpretation: Historical 350 W at 1000 rpm comparison only, not a prediction or the user's governing objective. Evaluate feasible sampled commands in the illustrative model. A failed sweep is not a proof about all possible hardware; a passing sweep would not be hardware validation.

sensitivity_check.note: Sensitivity only. 80 C is an assumed test corner, not an APW allowed winding temperature or established equilibrium. Flux, inductance, coercivity and heat transfer are held unchanged, so this is not a complete temperature model.

sources.title: MIT 6.061, Chapter 8: Electromagnetic forces and loss mechanisms
sources.use: Energy/coenergy treatment of force, torque, electrical and mechanical energy ports.
